question: Who is the current CEO of NVIDIA?

observations.content:
Summary: Jensen Huang, born in Taiwan, is the founder, president, and CEO of NVIDIA, a leading technology company. He has held these roles since the company's inception in 1993. Huang has been recognized for his leadership and contributions to the semiconductor industry.

[1] Jensen Huang - NVIDIA
    https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/board-of-directors/jensen-huang
    Jensen Huang founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as president, chief executive officer, and a member of the board of directors. Prior to founding NVIDIA, Mr. Huang held a variety of positions from 1985 to 1993 at LSI Logic Corp., a computer chip manufacturer, and from 1984 to 1985 at Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., a semiconductor company. In 2017, he was named Fortune’s Businessperson of the Year. In 2019, Harvard Business Review ranked him No. 1 on its list of the world’s [...] ## Jensen Huang

He has received the Daniel J. Epstein Engineering Management Award from the University of Southern California, an honorary doctorate from Taiwan’s National Chiao Tung University, and the EB Lemon Distinguished Alumni Award [...] Alumni Award and an honorary doctorate from Oregon State University. He was named to the U.S. Immigrant Entrepreneur Hall of Fame when it was established in 2012. In 2017, Harvard Business Review ranked him No. 1 on its list of the world’s 100 best-performing CEOs, and, in 2016, No. 1 in the U.S., over the lifetime of their tenure.
